raw_response:
I am renting this small plot, so I try not to spend too much cash on it. Beans do not need much fertilizer — they fix their own nitrogen — and here in Kagera we mostly plant our own saved seed together with banana or maize. I will weed carefully with my hoe and maybe throw a little manure from the neighbor's cattle around the banana stools, but I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or pesticide on a rented plot this season. I will do the work myself with help from my family.
